**With 20 documents, GPT-3.5-Turbo scores 75.8% when the answer document is first and 53.8% at its worst reported position, which is 2.3 points below its closed-book score of 56.1%.**

**Accuracy by position** (Table 6, page 18):

| Answer position | Accuracy |
|---|---|
| 1st | 75.8% |
| 5th | 57.2% |
| 10th (worst) | 53.8% |
| 15th | 55.4% |
| 20th | 63.2% |

The worst position is the 10th, in the middle of the context. That is 22.0 points below the first position. This matches the paper's statement that GPT-3.5-Turbo's performance "can drop by more than 20%" (page 5).

The table only reports positions 1, 5, 10, 15 and 20, so "worst" here means worst among those. Figure 1 plots every position, but its exact values aren't given as numbers (page 1).

**Compared with closed-book:** in the closed-book setting, GPT-3.5-Turbo gets 56.1% with no documents at all (Table 1, page 5). The paper confirms that in the worst case, performance in the 20- and 30-document settings "is lower than performance without any input documents (i.e., closed-book performance; 56.1%)" (page 5; also page 2).
